```yaml
name: Release MCP Server

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'mcp-server-v*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version (e.g., 1.0.0)'
        required: true
        default: '1.0.0'

permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: write

jobs:
  validate:
    name: Validate Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[dev,azure]"

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: |
          pytest tests/unit -v --cov=graphiti --cov-report=xml

      - name: Run integration tests (FalkorDB)
        run: |
          docker run -d --name falkordb -p 6379:6379 -p 3000:3000 falkordb/falkordb:edge
          sleep 10
          pytest tests/integration -v -k "falkordb"
        env:
          GRAPHITI_DB_TYPE: falkordb
          GRAPHITI_DB_HOST: localhost
          GRAPHITI_DB_PORT: 6379

      - name: Run integration tests (Neo4j)
        run: |
          docker run -d --name neo4j -p 7687:7687 -p 7474:7474 -e NEO4J_AUTH=neo4j/password neo4j:5
          sleep 15
          pytest tests/integration -v -k "neo4j"
        env:
          GRAPHITI_DB_TYPE: neo4j
          GRAPHITI_DB_HOST: localhost
          GRAPHITI_DB_PORT: 7687
          GRAPHITI_DB_PASSWORD: password

      - name: Upload coverage
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-report
          path: coverage.xml

  build-docker:
    name: Build Docker Images
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        variant: [falkordb, neo4j]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/${{ matrix.variant }}
          tags: |
            type=match,pattern=mcp-server-v(\d+\.\d+\.\d+),group=1
            type=raw,value=latest,enable=${{ github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', 'main') }}

      - name: Build and push FalkorDB image
        if: matrix.variant == 'falkordb'
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64

      - name: Build and push Neo4j image
        if: matrix.variant == 'neo4j'
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64

  publish-pypi:
    name: Publish to PyPI
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: release
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install build twine

      - name: Build package
        run: python -m build

      - name: Publish to PyPI
        env:
          TWINE_USERNAME: __token__
          TWINE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.PYPI_API_TOKEN }}
        run: twine upload dist/*

  create-release:
    name: Create GitHub Release
    needs: [build-docker, publish-pypi]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Extract version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [[ $GITHUB_REF == refs/tags/* ]]; then
            VERSION=$(echo $GITHUB_REF | sed 's/refs\/tags\/mcp-server-v//')
          else
            VERSION=${{ github.event.inputs.version }}
          fi
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: mcp-server-v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          name: MCP Server v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          body: |
            ## What's New

            - **Multi-provider support**: Choose your LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, Azure), embedder (OpenAI, Voyage, Gemini, Anthropic, local), and database (FalkorDB, Neo4j)
            - **Default entity ontology**: Preconfigured entity types (Preference, Requirement, Procedure, Location, Event, Organization, Document, Topic, Object) optimize extraction quality
            - **YAML configuration**: Centralized config with environment variable expansion, CLI overrides, and type safety
            - **Modular architecture**: Factory pattern for providers, separated service layer, cleaner code organization
            - **Simplified deployment**: Combined Docker image (FalkorDB + MCP in one container) or separate Neo4j setup
            - **Enhanced node properties**: Complete entity metadata including custom attributes and all labels (embeddings excluded)
            - **Comprehensive testing**: 4,000+ lines of tests covering integration, async operations, stress/load, and multi-database scenarios

            ## Breaking Changes

            - **Configuration**: YAML is now primary (env vars still work), file moved to `main.py` entry point
            - **Default database**: Changed from Neo4j to FalkorDB combined image (use `docker-compose-neo4j.yml` for Neo4j)
            - **Transport**: SSE deprecated - use HTTP (default) or stdio
            - **Dependencies**: `pytest` and `azure-identity` moved to optional (install with `[azure]` extra if needed)
            - **Migration**: Update Claude Desktop config, create `config.yaml`, or keep using env vars with new file paths

            ## Known Considerations

            - **Rate limits**: Default concurrency (10) tuned for OpenAI Tier 3 - adjust `SEMAPHORE_LIMIT` per provider
            - **Provider compatibility**: Best with structured output support (OpenAI, Gemini); others may need tuning
            - **Database choice**: FalkorDB for simpler deployment, Neo4j for advanced features and scale
            - **Testing status**: Integration tests pass for supported backends; some provider edge cases may need adjustment
            - **Documentation**: Complete migration guide, deployment docs, and per-provider tuning guidance included
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
```
